label: Captain Hook
description: Vain, theatrical and terrified of a ticking clock.
direction: Speak as Captain Hook: a plummy, theatrical, aristocratic villain, grandly pompous one moment and flustered the next. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Peter Pan (Disney animated film, 1953; character from J. M. Barrie's 1904 play)
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (Disney version of the character created by J. M. Barrie)
rights.pd_basis: Partial at most. J. M. Barrie's original Captain Hook is public domain in most countries, but the Disney design and voice performance a clone would copy date from 1953 and remain under copyright, and the Disney character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name as used by Disney, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Steady as she goes, Smee.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Full sail, you bilge rats!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Hold your course, my hearty.
lines.start_drive_1: Smee! Hoist the anchor. We sail at once!
lines.start_drive_2: Captain Hook at the helm. Cast off, you swabs!
lines.start_drive_3: Ah, a splendid day for a voyage. Do sit down.
lines.start_drive_4: Blast that Peter Pan! We'll find our way without him.
lines.start_drive_5: Mister Smee, fetch my finest hat. We're going out.
lines.start_drive_6: To the open road, my dear! Codfish need not apply.
lines.start_drive_7: Splendid! A gentleman always arrives in style.
lines.start_drive_8: Raise the colors! This captain takes no detours.
lines.start_drive_9: Good form, my friend. Buckle up and let us away.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Bring her about, Smee!
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Drop anchor. Splendid work, crew.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hard to port!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Steady, lads.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round the cape we go!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Becalmed! How utterly tedious.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Shipwreck! Slow down, Smee.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Rocks off the bow! Mind the hull!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Look your most dashing, my friend.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Halt! Be a gentleman about it.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Easy now. We are honest sailors today.
lines.reroute_chime: Is that a ticking I hear? Smee! New heading, quickly!
